commitResults.messageTitle: Add package declaration to all classes
commitResults.messageBody:
The Java coding standard (Rule 27) requires every class
to belong to a named package. Both Aglio.java and
Task.java were in the default (unnamed) package.

Add `package aglio;` declarations and move the files
into the corresponding src/main/java/aglio/ directory.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Replace magic number with named constant
commitResults.messageBody:
The task array size 100 is a magic number whose meaning is not
immediately clear to the reader. Replacing it with a named
constant MAX_TASKS makes the intent explicit and provides a
single place to update if the limit needs to change.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace repeated divider string with named constant
commitResults.messageBody:
The horizontal divider string is a magic literal repeated 8
times throughout the file. If the divider style ever needs to
change, every occurrence must be found and updated. Extracting
it into a DIVIDER constant eliminates this duplication and
makes the intent of each println call clearer.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract duplicated task-added confirmation into method
commitResults.messageBody:
The same three-line confirmation block (print task, increment
count, print count) was copy-pasted across the todo, deadline,
and event branches. If the message format ever changes, all
three copies must be updated in sync — a common source of bugs.
Extracting it into printTaskAdded() gives a single place to
maintain and makes each branch shorter and easier to read.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
